items.description: MacBook screen and lower-right corner impact damage
items.rationale: The evasive turn and door impact qualify under §§2.6.2–2.6.3 and 4.5.2, but neither the damage description nor a supplied schedule confirms that household contents and portable-equipment accidental damage cover were taken. If cover is confirmed, the comparable repair supports about €850 for the screen plus €360 for the corner, or €1,210 gross for one loss under §7.1.10, below the €1,400 equivalent-new benchmark, with no stated deductible to subtract.
